title: A useful message, without a stream
description: Generic info, message, warning and alert cards use the relay notification API. HTTP success means publication was accepted, not that someone saw the LCD.

title: Your computer, at a glance
description: Measured aggregate CPU usage and optional memory from a Linux companion. Missing values are not zero; CPU collection stays independent of notification capture failure.

title: Weather from your chosen source
description: One fresh weather snapshot supplied by an external client. No built-in provider, automatic location or offline cached-weather display.

title: Quiet when there is nothing to say
description: Device-local connected and disconnected orbital screensavers. The planned offline behavior also lets already accepted, unexpired generic cards finish; new delivery needs the relay.

title: Twitch when you want it
description: The existing Twitch dashboard, event cards and simulated stream remain. Relay display-override and runtime-monitoring APIs are installed; full device/admin/provider acceptance remains pending. Neither API starts a broadcast nor grants provider consent.

title: Private controls, not a public dashboard
description: A relay-served panel for display intent, monitoring and firmware-reported queue state. Legacy or stale reports stay unknown; ACKs and device reports do not prove visible pixels.

title: Desktop submissions, with explicit opt-in
description: Forwarding starts off. Once enabled, summary-only is the default; bodies need separate opt-in. Supported Freedesktop Notify submissions are the target, not every portal/native notification or guaranteed popup. Real desktop and installed-service acceptance remain pending.
